declined.reason: Not changed: the wizard's own checks preview_self_silent, adopted_init_guarded passed on this commit, and its checks outrank a reviewer's opinion.

review.summary: Host guards allow unknown hosts, Meta lacks SPA page views, and signup reporting is incomplete. GA4 delivery can also be lost during redirect. Production collection remains unproven.

checklist.note: All eight changed files are allowlisted or wizardFiles. No unrelated changes or package changes.
One GA4 loader/config and one Meta init remain. The removed GA4 duplicate used the same ID. Live beacon counts remain undetermined.
Existing GA4 and Meta initialization is edited in place, with their IDs preserved.
GA4 and Infinite match the plan, but Meta pixel 7777000011112222 is absent from connectedIds.meta, which is empty.
The adopted GA4 and Meta guards reject listed development hosts but allow every other unknown host, including custom preview hosts.
The existing consent-default snippet is unchanged, and the recorded mode matches not_required.
No secrets, environment values, server keys, or .env files are added. Tracking IDs and the verification artifact are public identifiers.
The signup event receives no form properties. Account emails and passwords are not passed to analytics, and there are no application identify calls.
Meta sends only its initial PageView. Infinite's history instrumentation does not send Meta page views; GA4's remote history settings cannot be checked offline.
not applicable: no server conversion lane is approved or installed. The browser signup event follows a successful API response; clicks are not reported as server outcomes.
not applicable: PostHog is not connected or installed. The only rewrite serves Infinite, and there is no GA4 proxy.
not applicable: no CSP exists in the supplied site files.
No generated/build output or dependency manifests are changed. No runtime dependency is added.
Managed files and application edits are recorded through files, contentHashes, configOwnership, or reversible textEdits.
The PR title/body and its measurement display were not supplied. verifiedAt is null, and production conversion checks have not run.
Successful signup is never sent to the connected Infinite collector, and the GA4 navigation wait is bypassed because its lane marker is never initialized.

findings.body: Meta configuration and reporting target pixel 7777000011112222, but the approved plan has connectedIds.meta: []. This destination has no matching connected ID, so its account routing cannot be certified against the plan.
findings.suggested_fix: Confirm the retained pixel is intended and connect/record that ID in the approved plan before certifying Meta collection. Preserve the existing ID unless a replacement is explicitly approved.

findings.body: The hostname guard returns true after checking its development-host exclusions. An unknown custom preview or staging hostname therefore initializes GA4; the identical Meta guard also permits it. The configured production host is shop.examplebrand.com, but the guard does not restrict collection to that host.
findings.suggested_fix: Allow only explicitly configured production hosts after normalization, and return false for every other host in both adopted guards.

findings.body: This is the only Meta PageView call, and the root Script does not rerun on Next.js Link navigation. The managed history listener emits only Infinite's site_page_view. Navigating from home to pricing to signup therefore produces no additional Meta page views.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a production-guarded route-change PageView for the existing pixel, with initial-load deduplication so the bootstrap and navigation hook cannot double count.

findings.body: infiniteTrackThenNavigate sends the signup event only through GA4/PostHog. It never calls Infinite's collector, while the native runtime emits only page views and click/submit intent events. Successful account creation consequently produces no approved signup outcome in the connected Infinite lane.
findings.suggested_fix: Use a supported Infinite success-event path after response.ok, keeping the approved signup outcome separate from click intent.

findings.body: The adopted GA4 configuration never sets window.__infiniteGa4Lane, and nothing else in the checkout sets it. The signup helper therefore always takes its unstarted-lane branch: it queues gtag('event', 'signup') and immediately calls location.assign. Its event_callback and bounded wait never execute, so navigation can abandon the conversion before dispatch.
findings.suggested_fix: Initialize the connected GA4 lane inside the production-only configuration branch, or explicitly wait for the adopted tag's event callback with a bounded navigation fallback.
